title: Rate Options Sheet — Non-Refundable Rate by Cancellation Policy
content:
# Rate options — the non-refundable rate

For reservations in the Stays (Guest Reservations) category, whether a guest may book at the non-refundable rate, and what it takes off, depends on the cancellation policy the stay is booked under.

| Cancellation policy | Non-refundable rate offered | Discount off the nightly subtotal | Refunded on a guest cancellation of a non-refundable stay |
|---|---|---|---|
| Flexible | No | 0.00% | 0.00% |
| Moderate | Yes | 10.00% | 0.00% |
| Limited | Yes | 10.00% | 0.00% |
| Firm | Yes | 10.00% | 0.00% |
| Strict | Yes | 10.00% | 0.00% |
| Super Strict 30 Days | No | 0.00% | 0.00% |
| Super Strict 60 Days | No | 0.00% | 0.00% |
| Long-Term | No | 0.00% | 0.00% |

- **Non-refundable rate offered** — whether a guest may book this policy at the non-refundable rate.
- **Discount off the nightly subtotal** — the percent taken off the nightly subtotal for the non-refundable rate; 0.00% where the option is not offered.
- **Refunded on a guest cancellation** — the percent of any component refunded when the guest cancels a stay booked at the non-refundable rate.

## Points of reading

- Only Moderate, Limited, Firm and Strict offer the non-refundable rate, each at 10.00% off the nightly subtotal.
- Flexible, Super Strict 30 Days, Super Strict 60 Days and Long-Term do not offer it; their discount figure of 0.00% only records that.
- On every policy, a guest cancellation of a non-refundable stay refunds 0.00% of every component.

## Illustration (hypothetical figures)

On a hypothetical Firm stay whose nightly price total is 2,000.00, the non-refundable rate takes 10.00% off, that is 200.00, leaving a nightly subtotal of 1,800.00. If the guest later cancels that stay, 0.00% of each component is refunded.
